To her shock, her superior assigns her a new task: to protect Ethan and uncover the mastermind behind the relentless attacks on the Brown’s. For Brielle, accepting the mission is a bitter pill to swallow, given her lack of trust in the family she blames for her father’s death...

title: Off-Screen Lovers
desc: Anna Grove and Josh Lark enter a sham marriage after Jack Moss's car accident, concealing their true feelings. As they work together on set, honesty begins to blend with affection. Eventually, secrets are uncovered, misunderstandings are healed, and they reach a heartfelt ending sealed by true love.

title: The Grand Deception
desc: After a planned car accident leaves heiress Chloe Hayes in a coma, her husband turns into a completely different person and enemies close in. Chloe, using her blindness and amnesia as a shield, navigates through constant peril. As the truth comes to light, deep betrayals and hidden secrets are revealed. In this ruthless world, can Chloe reclaim her life and outwit her enemies?

title: The Pinnacle Club
desc: Bella and her sister Molly have always relied on each other. Molly's future looked bright with her plans to study abroad, but everything came crashing down when she fell naked to her death from the Sterling Corporation building. The brutal truth? The chairman raped her, and his son pushed her. Yet, thanks to their immense power, the Sterlings walked free, the case ruled an accident. Devastated, Bella vows to take them down, only to be manipulated by Ethan, the chairman's illegitimate son, who sees her as the perfect weapon against his own family. Thrust into a world of wealth and dark secrets, Bella uses her rage to fuel family infighting. But as sparks fly between her and Ethan, and just when she thinks she's achieved her revenge, she realizes the real storm is only just beginning…

title: Against the Light
desc:
"Isabella Williams is the perfect heiress, but her tragic past hides deep scars: her father's murder and mother's suicide, caused by Owen Reed's obsession. Now living under a false name, she plans her escape from the Reed family.

When she rescues Henry, the Northern Faction leader, from a fake assassination attempt, he falls for her instantly. She sees him as her only way out. As he helps her face her dark past, she can't help but fall for him too..."

title: Contract's End, Prey's Fate
desc: George's unrequited love for Julia turns into a tumultuous marriage, arranged by her father to keep her away from her true love, Ethan. Despite George's dedication, Julia's heart belongs to Ethan. When Julia unexpectedly becomes pregnant after Ethan's return, secrets and heartbreak unfold. A tragic misunderstanding breaks them apart, and George leaves devastated. But when Julia's world falls apart, she discovers George is her last hope. Can she win him back or has she lost him forever to another woman?

title: His Bride Her Revenge
desc: Three years ago, framed Leah stumbled into Ernest Servaes', the nation's richest scion's room. Amidst a raging fire, she saved him but lost her mother's ring—the key to reclaiming her stolen family fortune.Three years on, Ernest journeyed to the Dauriac residence to formally seek her hand in marriage. Thus began a new chapter in their lives, where Leah and Ernest, each burdened with hidden agendas, navigated a delicate dance of mutual probing and support.

title: I Forgot I Married Him
desc: After a car accident, Alice loses her memory—and forgets the betrayal that destroyed her marriage. She wakes up believing she’s still the sweet, innocent girl she once was… until she realizes everyone around her sees her as a villainous wife. Her cold husband, her fake best friend, her broken vows—everyone wants her to stay quiet. But the new Alice has other plans. This time, she’ll make them all pay for the lies that ruined her life.

title: When Love Finally Found Me
desc: Ruby Earl, plagued by insecurities due to a birthmark on her face, is coerced by her family into working to support them during college. One time at work, she faces danger but is saved by the heir of the Sage family, Brian Sage. Ruby unexpectedly becomes pregnant and is whisked away by Brian. As their bond deepens over time, they unravel the mystery of Ruby's lineage.

title: Desire Under Our Uniforms
desc: Wrongfully accused of thesis plagiarism, medical grad Kelly can’t find work. She rescues an elder, Carl, who gets her a job at a military hospital—where the director is Carl’s grandson George, her contractual husband.Kelly hides their marriage to avoid attention, but is harassed by George’s admirer Victoria. George defends her, and their contractual bond grows into real affection as they spend time together.

title: Claiming His Angel in White
desc: When nurse Aspen saves a gravely wounded stranger, she has no idea he’s Ivan — a feared mafia boss. Drawn to her gentle spirit, Ivan falls for her at first sight and uses every means to keep her close, even sabotaging her relationship with her boyfriend, Phillip. Though Aspen resists his control, she soon discovers the warmth hidden beneath his cold exterior. Through danger, betrayal, and passion, she begins to see people’s true hearts — and her own.

title: From Outcast to Overlord
desc: Ethan transmigrated to the Primal Continent and joined a declining sect. After 10 wasted years and a broken engagement, he awakened a Divine Emperor System. While recruiting 10-star disciples, he crushed foes and served flood dragon soup and longevity peaches to his guests.

title: The Girl We Three Left Behind
cleanTitle: The Girl We Three Left Behind
desc: Zoey Lopez sacrificed herself to save her brother and three childhood sweethearts, only to wake from a three-year coma and find herself replaced by her adopted sister, Yvonne. Rejected by her family, Zoey decided to cut all ties, leaving them to drown in regret and face their ultimate betrayal.

title: Two-Life Revenge
desc: Sylvia time-traveled to her engagement, and exposed her fiancé's infidelity. Then she worked at Stewart Media and fell in love with Jaden. Driven by jealousy, her fiancé framed Jaden but failed. When they finally got married, she discovered that Jaden also time traveled. They joined hands to fight against fate.

title: Rising from the Flame
desc: Eve was once adopted by the rich Smith family but poisoned by her jealous sister. After both girls time-travel back before the adoption, Eve's sister rushes to join the Smiths, while Eve finds true love with the York family. She guards her kin from adversaries, and gradually falls for her former rival Jasper.

title: The Revenge of a Good Girl
cleanTitle: The Revenge of a Good Girl
desc: Beth Stoke has been abused and used by the Stoke family since she was a kid. To take revenge, she schemes to marry Rory Hawn. She uses him to expose the villains' crimes, punish them and take back her mother's work. For Rory, it’s a contract marriage but they fall in love in the end.

title: The Rescue
desc: Roger's mistress Lily plots to kill his wife Amy, but accidentally causes his daughter Becky to fall and suffer critical injuries. Mistakenly believing Amy is in the ambulance, Lily crashes into it to stop the rescue, while Roger—unaware it's his daughter—also obstructs the life-saving efforts, leading to Becky's death. When the truth is exposed, they face the consequences of their evil deeds.

title: Stepmother's Revenge
desc: Betrayed and heartbroken, she stuns all by marrying her ex's powerful father. Now his stepmother, she masterminds a delicious revenge within the elite family. Through the chaos, she finds true love with the commanding CEO and claims her crown.

title: The Unspoken Solitude
desc: Born to be nothing more than a living blood bank for her cruel sister, Stella breaks free from her toxic family to forge a new destiny. As shocking secrets are revealed, she finds unexpected love, but her past returns for a final, deadly confrontation that will change everyone's lives forever.

title: Love's Second Chance
desc: Nikki, heiress of the Wilson family, endured years of emotional abuse in a cold and loveless marriage with Charlie. Ignored, humiliated, and betrayed, her life ended in a tragic car accident—only for her burning resentment to rewind time by a year. This time, Nikki is determined to leave the man who destroyed her, reclaim her dignity, and rewrite her fate.

title: Alice Unchained
desc: Famous fashion designer Alice hides her heiress identity to marry the man she loves, only to endure bullying and cruel misunderstandings from his family. When she reclaims her true identity and chooses supermodel Jack, her husband is left in regret. But will Alice ever forgive him—or has she found her true love at last?

title: Wicked Protagonist
desc: After being secretly attacked, Lucian traveled to another world and grew stronger with Holt Jade and supreme cultivation techniques. Faced with conspiracies, she struck back with overwhelming force, shining in the Heaven Essence Sect's assessment, and began a vigorous journey of vengeance and thrilling payback.

title: Cherished by My Sweet Zaddy
desc: Mia was harassed in a bar and saved by a stranger named Patrick. Mia left quietly after they spent the night together. A month later, Mia, who is pregnant, bumps into Patrick and learns that he is the master of the Ford family. Patrick decides to protect Mia, but she has to face not only pressure from her so-called family, but also hostility from Patrick's friends. Moreover, the birthmark on her face is gone, reveals an undiscovered truth about where she was from...

title: The Baby Sis Strikes Back
desc: Hailey, adopted by a janitor, became a model but broke her legs saving Marcus. After he married and cheated on her, her powerful family finally found her. Her three older brothers and fiancé stood by her side, helping her reclaim her life and dignity.

title: Love Heals the World
desc: Lost since childhood, Clara grew up in an orphanage with a hidden gift for healing. She was nearly taken in by the Seine Family, but instead was adopted by the elite Foster Family. From curing the Madam to being revealed as their biological daughter, Clara became the beloved jewel of the family.

title: Switching Husband：Reborn to be the Colonel’s Bride
cleanTitle: Switching Husband：Reborn to be the Colonel’s Bride
desc: Serena and Lola, sisters reborn five years into the past, clash over rewriting their fates. Lola steals Serena's former mayor husband Gilbert, unaware of his family's corruption, while Serena is forced to marry 'psycho' Dorian Austen—who is secretly the son of a marshal undercover to investigate political enemies. With resilience, Serena wins Dorian's love and exposes Lola and the Duvalls' schemes. After Dorian's identity is revealed, Serena endures persecution from her stepmother and sister but upholds justice. At the Soldier's Day event, Lola and Gilbert frame Serena for attempting to murder Mrs. Kensington, leading to a courtroom showdown.

title: The Mafia's Unwanted Blind Savior
desc: Fifteen years ago, Lila risked her life to save young Steve, leaving only a crescent moon necklace. Years later, he married her after a whirlwind one-night stand but mistakenly believed Clara was his savior. Cold to Lila, little did he know—his true white moonlight was his wife all along.

title: My Intern Is a Hollywood Star
cleanTitle: My Intern Is a Hollywood Star
desc: Charlotte is a hardworking intern who never imagined her idol, superstar Freddy Jones, would fall for her. To keep his secret, Freddy disguises himself as an intern, standing by her side against jealous rivals and pulling her into a whirlwind romance she can’t resist.

title: Oops! Daddy's the Grumpy Boss
desc: Anna Louis was drugged by her stepmother and stepsister, leading to an accidental night with Nate Boston. Five years later, she gave birth to quadruplets. To raise the four kids, she worked two jobs, unaware that the boss behind both jobs was their father, Nate, a sharp-tongued man pretending to be disabled.

title: One More Taste of Love
desc: Humiliated on her own wedding day, Ava’s childhood crush becomes her cold, distant husband.Married for status, not love, Ava enters a world where appearance is everything—and she’s never been enough. Mocked and dismissed, she quietly decides to prove them all wrong. But her transformation isn't just physical—it's a journey of self-worth, passion, and rediscovering her own voice.What she doesn’t expect is Alfie—her aloof husband—starting to see her for who she really is. The girl he once knew. The woman he can’t ignore. As the lines between duty and desire blur, Alfie finds himself falling—hard—for the wife he never thought he needed.

title: Call Me By Her Name
desc: Annette thought she had it all—a thriving career as an OB-GYN, a successful husband, and a baby on the way—until one betrayal revealed the truth: she was never the one. She had been someone’s stand-in all along. Even her name was borrowed from the woman who came before. As her perfect life unravels, Annette must find the courage to leave behind the life that was never truly hers—and the strength to rebuild one that finally is.

title: The Vengeance of a Resurrected Man
cleanTitle: The Vengeance of a Resurrected Man
desc: Kaden spent thirty years in prison for saving Souline, only to die with nothing. But when resurrected in 2001, he changed his fate. With future knowledge, he struck gold, building a real estate empire. When Souline's family came for him again, he outsmarted them and started fresh with Yareli.

title: Surrogate For My Ex's Billionaire Uncle
cleanTitle: Surrogate For My Ex's Billionaire Uncle
desc: Lila Reed, a girl who longed for a happy family, was betrayed by her scumbag boyfriend. Driven by her wish to have a child, she decided to use donor sperm and accidentally met Adrian Crawford the billionaire CEO who needed a contract wife. In the end, the two gradually discovered their true feelings for each other and got happily married.

title: Tell Me You Love Me
desc: Joyce, the capital's most elegant socialite, enters a marriage of convenience with ruthless CEO Justin. He sees her as just another dull trophy wife—until she shocks him by demanding a divorce. Suddenly, the boring girl he ignored reveals hidden depths, forcing Justin to question everything he thought he knew about love.

title: Wonder Lady
desc:
Juliet Yale transmigrates into a novel by accident and becomes a noble couple’s long-lost daughter. Her once-doomed family members turn calamities into blessings by reading her mind. Thanks to her, 
they change their destinies while the villains get what they deserve.

title: The Doomed Pawn's Fate-changing Game
desc: Sherry was transmigrated into a world where her children were destined to be tragic side characters.  She helped her son reclaim his legacy and her daughter overcome insecurity.  When David entered their lives, the family united to defy fate and rewrite their story.

title: The Alpha King's Mistake
desc: Harper, a rare tri-bred is rejected by her fated mate Vance, the future Alpha King. Used as a pawn by her powerful father, she’s torn between love and revenge. To survive, Harper must embrace her true power and uncover the secrets of her bloodline.

title: Woke Up Married to My Crush
cleanTitle: Woke Up Married to My Crush
desc: After a devastating accident, Alice wakes up to a life she doesn't recognize - a ruthless billionaire husband, a marriage filled with distrust, and a rival who wants her gone. Stripped of her past but armed with newfound courage, she must untangle the truths and reclaim the fragments of what once were hers.

title: The Lost Heiress's Vengeance
desc: Sheila Yorks, once a lost heiress, was taken by the Joneses. Shirley Jones, their real daughter, framed Sheila for her biological father's hit-and-run murder. Now, given a second chance in life, Sheila seeks revenge on them all.

title: Executive Affair：Resigning From Your Love
desc: After years of quiet devotion as a CEO’s assistant and secret lover, all Pearl got in return was news of his engagement to a wealthy heiress. Heartbroken and humiliated, she tried to walk away—but life had other plans. A surprise pregnancy. Her father’s crushing debts. No one to turn to. For the first time, Pearl swore she wouldn’t go crawling back to the man who broke her... But Henry isn't ready to lether go, and neither is the world that binds them together.

title: When Pretend Turns Real
desc: New at Johns Pharma, Ryan's boss, Brianna, asked him to pretend to be her boyfriend. Reluctant at first, Ryan stumbled upon a system rewarding him with skills and knowledge just by reading. Brianna's family adored him, and she too wished their act was real. Empowered, Ryan's ascent to success began!

title: Vows That Bind the Kingdom
desc: Reborn in silk, armed with steel.Fenella Muir, an agent from the 22nd century, will teach her ancient enemies what true revenge looks like.

title: A Profound Love As the Sea
cleanTitle: A Profound Love As the Sea
desc: When a hidden heiress sacrifices everything for the man she believes once saved her, only to be betrayed by his lies and infidelity, she rises from the ashes of a broken marriage—unveiling her true power and reclaiming her life, love, and legacy in a storm of revelation and revenge.

cleanTitle: Until I Forgot to Love You
desc: Helen endured years of gaslighting from her husband Mark. Pregnant with their second child, she discovered Mark’s plan to flee to Italy with his grad student—and their twelve-year-old daughter Sophie. Sophie, bribed by the mistress, publicly called Helen her “annoying nanny” and shoved her, causing a miscarriage. Mark’s response on a video call: “That’s probably for the best.” After a car accident left Helen with amnesia, Mark locked her in a psychiatric ward. Three months later, she returned home playing the docile, broken wife—while secretly moving assets and copying evidence. The night Mark brought a psychologist to “reprogram” her, Helen took off her glasses and said: “I remember everything. The divorce papers are filed.” Three weeks of silence bought her the fall of an empire.

title: He Drowned His Pregnant Wife for Another Woman
cleanTitle: He Drowned His Pregnant Wife for Another Woman
desc: She once saved his life, married him with all her heart, and carried his child. But for his beloved mistress, he locked his pregnant wife in a rusted iron cage and drowned her in the icy lake. She died with their unborn baby, then returned as a ghost to watch him fall apart. He thought it was just a punishment, until he dragged her blood-soaked corpse from the lake—only to discover the cruel truth behind everything. Who really set her up?

title: Five Years of IVF While He Already Had Twins
cleanTitle: Five Years of IVF While He Already Had Twins
desc:
I almost died on the operating table trying to give Alexander Volkov a child, unaware he already had a pair of illegitimate twins with his childhood sweetheart.
My heart stopped when I saw the DNA results. Alec, the man who made the New York underworld tremble, the man who flew back on a private jet just to hold my hand, was a flawless liar.
I turned my face away, tears soaking the hospital pillow. My hand drifted to my belly. God had finally decided to give me a break after five years of needles and agony—I was pregnant. But now, it felt like the cruelest joke.
He pulled me into his arms, smelling of expensive cologne and... baby formula.
"Tell me what's wrong, honey. Whoever made you unhappy, I'll make them pay."
I stared into his lying eyes and made my decision. 
I would vanish with his unborn child, leaving him to rot in eternal regret.

title: Kill Me, Save Me
desc: After his girlfriend Aurora Golde's tragic death, Noah Stark loses his sanity. He feigns recovery upon release from the hospital, carefully setting a web of revenge and turning Jerry Fox and Jade White against each other. When the truth comes to light, he faces justice—the cost he willingly pays for the love of his life.

title: Secret on the Yoga Mat
desc: "Sophia believed her first love's lies, watched her daughter in danger and did nothing, convinced her husband George was a greedy fraud. Then the truth exploded—the man she despised was the silent force behind her success, while the one she trusted was stealing George's research and her fortune. By the time she understood, it was too late: George had moved on with the woman who always loved him, and her daughter had happily found a new mom. Left with nothing but regret, she realized some wounds never heal. ""The one you pushed away was the only one who ever held you up."

title: Go Save Your Precious, I'll Save Myself
cleanTitle: Go Save Your Precious, I'll Save Myself
desc: I spent five years paying for a mistake I didn't make. In my last life, my fiancé Callum chose to save me instead of the woman he loved—and he made me suffer for it every day until we both died at the bottom of the ocean. Now, I’ve woken up on that same island, at the moment of the crash. This time, I’m giving him what he wants. "Take her and go," I told him, watching as he abandoned me to a wild bear without looking back. But I’m not a victim anymore. I’m saving myself, and the mysterious man who rescues me has no intention of ever letting me go back to the monster who left me to die.

title: My Stepson，My Mate
desc: Forced into a marriage with the powerful old Alpha Mason, Alice becomes his "legal trophy wife," only to discover a devastating secret on her wedding night: Mason’s son, Noah, is her fated mate. Bound by a biological bond they can't fight, the arrogant young Alpha is torn between his hatred for Alice’s family and his primal urge to claim her. As Alice plays a dangerous game, using her status as Mason’s wife to drive Noah mad with jealousy, the tension between stepmother and stepson reaches a breaking point. In a house of secrets and betrayal, Alice must choose between the man who owns her and the one her soul demands.

title: Marking the Alpha My Cousin Couldn't Tame
cleanTitle: Marking the Alpha My Cousin Couldn't Tame
desc: woke up twenty-three again, and the first thing I did was steal my cousin’s mating contract. In my last life, I watched her fade into a ghost wife, unbonded and unloved for fifty years. Not this time. I drove across the country to claim Kaelen Thornfield—the coldest, most powerful Alpha in the West. He expected a submissive mate; I gave him grease-stained arms and a bite to the neck. "Marks aren't given. They're taken," I told his shocked pack. Now, I’m tearing off the mask of his "innocent" mistress and teaching this Alpha that I don't just follow the bond—I own it.

title: How to Become a Villainess
desc:
"In my past life, my deceitful brother Matthew drained my talents, used me as his scapegoat, and ultimately killed me. Reborn, I watch as he rises to power with my poetry.

At a royal banquet, I publicly expose his fraud, reclaiming all I gave him—my talent, fame, and future. Just as I turn to leave, the Fourth Prince Alexander, my secret ally, steps forward and says, ""This time, let me protect you."""

title: Stolen Night with the Police Chief
cleanTitle: Stolen Night with the Police Chief
desc: A drunken one-night stand with the new police chief, Darren, was supposed to be Nora’s secret. But when her best friend Mary steals her identity and climbs into Darren’s bed, Nora is forced to watch as the imposter steals her life. While Mary schemes with a mole to frame her, Darren begins to suspect the woman in his arms is a fraud. Nora must expose the lie and reclaim her place in the Chief’s heart before she’s sent to prison for a crime she didn't commit.

title: A Teacher's Downfall
desc:
"Miss Smith, I think I can smell your scent... it's so womanly..."
I looked down at the boy hiding under the lectern, watching helplessly as he had his way with me right there in the classroom, while I had to pretend everything was normal...



My name is Catherine, the university math teacher. With my husband always away on business trips, at thirty years old, I was like a nun guarding that double bed, never satisfied. Slowly, I developed some strange habits... and became bolder...



The bell for the end of class had just rung, and teachers and students were flocking to the bathrooms in groups, chattering noisily outside.



In one of the bathroom stalls, I was panting, squatting... my black lace panties down around my ankles, my face flushed with ecstasy as I indulged...

title: The CEO’s Stolen Identity
desc: Melanie Walton, the secret wife of billionaire Lucas Walton, goes undercover as an intern to save his company. But when the butler’s daughter steals her identity and seduces her husband, Melanie is treated like trash in her own empire. Subjected to brutal bullying and stripped of her dignity, she must watch as an imposter lives her life. Now, the real Queen must stop hiding and destroy everyone who tried to steal her throne.

title: One Night Stand with My Father's Killer
cleanTitle: One Night Stand with My Father's Killer
desc:
After his tycoon father's death, Theodore's life falls apart. He escapes an attempted rape by a former friend, only to be rescued by Derek, with whom he shares a one-night stand. 
The next day, Theodore flees in panic—his first time with a man—and retreats to his only inheritance: a yacht moored off the Italian coast. There, he turns to drugs to numb his turmoil.
When Derek unexpectedly boards the yacht, Theodore, denying his attraction, orders him to leave. But as threats return, he must rely on Derek for protection. 
Their journey becomes a haze of drugs, desire, and growing tension—until Theodore uncovers a shocking truth: Derek may be linked to his father’s death.

title: Surrender to the Silver Fox: The Master's Contract
cleanTitle: Surrender to the Silver Fox: The Master's Contract
desc: Celia’s world shatters when her father sells her virginity to the ruthless Amul mafia family. Just as she faces a living nightmare, Pierre—a powerful, silver-haired tycoon and her father’s oldest friend—intervenes and claims her as his own. But his rescue comes with a price: a secret contract demanding her total obedience to his every whim. As Pierre pushes her to the edge of desire with calculated discipline, Celia finds herself falling for the very devil who controls her breath. When she is forced into a black wedding dress by his enemies, Pierre shatters the altar with a private army, proving that no one takes what belongs to the Silver Fox.

title: I Left the Mafia Don, Married His Rival
cleanTitle: I Left the Mafia Don, Married His Rival
desc:
I'm an OB-GYN. On Valentine's Day, I pulled a ring out of a woman's vagina.
It turned out to be my husband's wedding ring.
An hour before, he'd texted me. Said he loved me. Said he was too busy with work to come home.
I wanted a divorce. Needed one. But then I found out—our marriage was never registered.
In his manor, I was nothing. Just a fake wife.
He grabbed me by the throat—right in front of his mistress. Called me "damaged goods." Said I'd spent a year in another man's house.
But that year, I went as a hostage in his place.
I ran. Made it to the cliff's edge, covered in blood. And the man who saved me? The mafia godfather who'd held me captive that whole year.
He looked at me. "Marry me."

title: I Married the Man Who Planned My Rape
cleanTitle: I Married the Man Who Planned My Rape
desc:
I thought my husband was my salvation.
Until I overheard him in the wine cellar, laughing and joking with my "attackers" from that night.
The gang rape that destroyed me was a show he orchestrated himself.

He married me only for inheritance rights.
He humiliated me, branded me, took away my child, and made my life a living hell.
But he forgot one thing—
The ancient blood oath of the Corleone family states clearly:
If a husband betrays his marriage, everything he owns shall belong to his wife.

This time, I'm no longer the rabbit waiting to be slaughtered.
This time, I write the ending.

title: The Billionaire's Too Late Repentance
desc: After her husband Bradley stood by while his mistress crushed her sculpting hand and forced her to sign a divorce on her knees, Charlotte vanished into the storm. Two years later, she returns as a world-renowned artist, only for a devastated Bradley to finally learn the truth: Charlotte was the one who saved his life all along. He’ll tear the city apart and crawl through glass to win her back, but Charlotte has a new life—and a new man. Is his blood-soaked repentance enough, or is it simply far too late?

title: The Captain's Forbidden Cure
desc:
No one knew I was an addict. 
Not to alcohol, not to drugs, but to the rawest, dirtiest kind of union. 
To keep up the facade of this respectable job, to stop myself from turning into some desperate, heat-crazed stray begging for a man’s touch on the street, I had to swallow those little blue pills every day. 
Until that damn blizzard trapped me with thirty hockey players reeking of sweat and testosterone, and my pills—gone.

title: I'll Stock Your Fridge, My Glutton Bride
cleanTitle: I'll Stock Your Fridge, My Glutton Bride
desc: Saskia—the unloved heiress and insatiable foodie—hires a penniless Hudson to fake-wed her and escape Zeke, only to learn he's the richest bachelor and she saved him before. Together they tackle eating contests, family conspiracies and a deadly fire before feasting on their own sweet happily-ever-after.

title: （Dubbed）Crack of Light
desc: An unexpected night leaves George, driver for Clark Corp, in bed with Diana, heir to Percy Corp. Drawn to him, Diana makes George her personal driver and soon falls in love. But George harbors a dark secret—he's out for revenge against the Clark family. When Diana learns the truth, she chooses to marry Mr. Clark. With truth and lies tangled together, how will this love story born from deceit unfold...

title: [Dubbled]Mr. Sterling's Fiery Sweetheart
desc: Seven years ago, Grace stumbled mistakenly into the hotel room of Damien, the enigmatic CEO of Sterling Group. That one passionate night resulted in twin boys. In a cruel twist of fate, her eldest son was stolen and abandoned, leaving only little Leo by her side. Fast forward seven years, and Grace returns home with Leo, determined to find her lost son. When she unexpectedly crosses paths with Damien once more, sparks fly, but neither recognizes the other... What will happen when the truth comes to light?

title: His Caged Bird Doesn't Beg
desc:
Everyone in our circle knows I'm Adrian's caged bird, and the "bad woman" his son Miles hates most.
For Miles, I gave up my fellowship in Zurich and spent seven years playing housewife.
What did I get in return? Adrian took Sophie to gallery openings on our anniversary. Miles smashed cake in my face in front of everyone, calling me a frumpy housewife.
Adrian was certain I couldn't leave him. Certain I couldn't leave our son.

He threw the divorce papers on the table with a cold smile. "Sign this, and you lose everything. Including Miles."
He expected me to beg on my knees.
I didn't.
I picked up the pen and signed without hesitation.
"Fine, Adrian. You keep Miles. And I get to keep myself."
For just a moment, I saw shock flash in his eyes.
I heard later that Adrian searched for me like a madman, and the son he doted on cried and screamed for his mommy.
Too bad. I'd already burned it all down myself.

title: My Boyfriend's Last Kiss
desc:
At a late-night party, when the bottle spins to my boyfriend Tyler, he picks dare.
"Kiss anyone here except your girlfriend," the host announces with a smirk.
Tyler barely hesitates. He walks straight to my best friend Sienna and kisses her for a full seven seconds in front of everyone.
When he comes back, he leans close to my ear. "Don't sweat it, we'll have fun when we get home."
When it's my turn, I choose truth. "Tell us a secret nobody knows."
I look around at all these drunk college kids, then say calmly, "I killed someone."

title: My Perfect Husband's Betrayal
desc:
Everyone says I married the perfect husband—considerate, devoted, loving.
I thought I had happiness too, until my neighbor told me she'd seen "me" having sex with Declan multiple times over the summer, even against the floor-to-ceiling windows. But during those two months, I'd been with my son out of town the entire time.
I rushed home and heard 8-year-old Beckett on the phone, bragging to his father: "Dad, I got Mom out of the way for two whole months. Did you make up with your sweetheart? Where's my allowance?"
I pulled up the security footage and saw a woman wearing my nightgown, with my husband, in every corner of our home... I spent eight years building this family, and they betrayed me together.

title: Divorced Ten Times for Her
desc:
Everyone knows Adrian loves me more than life itself. When that car crashed, he threw himself over me and took the hit. First thing he said when he woke up in the hospital: "Where is she? Is she okay?"
Everyone says I married the best man in the city.
What they don't know is this man has married me ten times. And divorced me ten times. All for the woman he's never gotten over.
The first time, I got on my knees and begged him not to leave. He just looked at me with those cold eyes and said, "Don't embarrass yourself."
The fourth time, we were fighting in the car. Then we crashed, and I lost our baby.
By the seventh time, I stopped crying. Just signed the papers, packed my things, waited for him to come back like he always did.
My tears, my compromises, all those times I bent until I nearly broke. What did I get? Him coming back like clockwork, just to do it all over again.
This time, when he slides that tenth divorce agreement across the desk, I finally get it. Some people's hearts never had room for you in the first place.
So this time, I'm throwing him out. Him and this whole Mrs. Hayes charade. Straight into the trash where they belong.

title: Crashing into His Vengeance
desc:
I am the jubilant champion's girlfriend, the blissful woman who will reveal to him tonight, "We are to become parents." Yet, I overheard the brutal truth: "The very thought of her mother once climbing into my father's bed fills me with revulsion for every second of this five-year charade." 
It turns out that five years of affection was nothing more than a meticulously orchestrated deceit. 
In that moment of heartbreak and excruciating pain, our child slipped away as if making the final decision on my behalf. I incinerated all our memories, rendering them vapor in this world. 
When that once indomitable champion finally realized his misplaced animosity, and in a desperate bid to find me, fractured his spine amidst the ruins while signing a pact with fate...I am the jubilant champion's girlfriend, the blissful woman who will reveal to him tonight, "We are to become parents." Yet, I overheard the brutal truth: "The very thought of her mother once climbing into my father's bed fills me with revulsion for every second of this five-year charade." 
It turns out that five years of affection was nothing more than a meticulously orchestrated deceit. 
In that moment of heartbreak and excruciating pain, our child slipped away as if making the final decision on my behalf. 
When that once indomitable champion finally realized his misplaced animosity, and in a desperate bid to find me, fractured his spine amidst the ruins while signing a pact with fate...

title: Falling In Love With My CEO Husband In Parallel
cleanTitle: Falling In Love With My CEO Husband In Parallel
desc: After a fierce battle, powerful sorceress Elizebeth Starwhisper is struck by a rival's spell, sending her across time and space into the 21st century—and into the body of drowned heiress Elizabeth Rockfield. Suddenly revived, Elizabeth must adapt to survive, learning the secrets of modern money-making while cleverly applying her mystical skills in unexpected ways. Meanwhile, her arranged-marriage husband, Frank, LA's youngest billionaire, notices that his "wife" seems like a whole new person—and for the first time, he's falling in love with her.

title: (DUBBED)A Mother's Redemption
desc:
On her deathbed, a powerful matriarch discovers her greatest mistake—protecting the wrong woman and losing her true family. 
Given a second chance, Sophia wakes three years in the past, determined to shield her loyal daughter-in-law and rewrite their fate. 
This time, Sophia'll stop at nothing to protect the love and happiness her family deserves.

title: Go Save Your Sweetheart
desc:
Ambushed by a rival syndicate. My mafia husband had to choose — save me, or save his childhood sweetheart.
I was five months pregnant with his heir. She was the love of his life.
He chose me. She died.
He said it was fine. Took time off work. Bought out every baby store in the city. Made me warm milk every night.
I thought I'd finally won his heart.
Until the day our son was born. He carried our baby to her grave.
My son never came back.
"You thought you won? The day she died, you were already dead to me. I just needed the heir first."
Then he had me beaten to death beside her tombstone.
When I opened my eyes again, I was back in that ambush.
This time, I let go of his sleeve.
Go save your sweetheart. I'm done begging.

title: Then Us, Now Gone
desc:
"Janet Sheen gave up her life as the Sheen family heiress just to marry Timothy Lowe, a poor nobody at the time. She poured everything she had into helping him rise to the top and build Greenfield Group from scratch. For five years, their marriage seemed perfect—Timothy was loving, devoted, and Janet truly believed he would keep his promise to love her and only her for a lifetime.
 But just as Janet was convinced their happiness would last, Timothy's nanny, Nancy, suddenly returned from overseas. She insisted on moving in as Timothy's ""personal housekeeper"" The relationship between them was anything but normal, and Nancy's intentions were clearly suspect.
 Despite Janet’s repeated warnings, Timothy stubbornly kept Nancy in the house. Slowly but surely, cracks began to appear in their marriage..."

title: My call boy, my loyal CEO!
cleanTitle: My call boy, my loyal CEO!
desc:
Zoe is a computer genius, but she mistakenly identified Daniel as her benefactor and married him.
After three years of marriage, Zoe realized that Daniel didn’t love her at all—instead, he had always looked down on her and used her. Framed by Daniel, she was forced out of their joint company with nothing and lost the patents she had already registered. Choosing to divorce, Zoe started over and launched her own business. To protect her patent ownership, Zoe decided to have a child to inherit them. In a hurry, she sought a "cheap and reliable" male escort for the purpose, only to end up with the young and exceptional Noah. Though she never intended to fall in love, Zoe found herself ensnared in the seductive trap of this domineering CEO...

title: Harvested for My Adopted Sister's Heart
cleanTitle: Harvested for My Adopted Sister's Heart
desc:
Six months after our bonding ceremony, I was ambushed by rogue wolves while searching for rare herbs in the Black Forest.
Their poisoned claws shredded my abdomen—and with it, any chance of ever carrying pups.
But my mate held my hand and wept. My mother swore she'd save me. My father said everything would be fine.
How pathetic—
Right before they wheeled me into surgery, I heard them through a cracked door, calmly discussing how to harvest my heart for the adopted sister who'd been waiting six months.
Turns out the "accident" was a gift from my loving family of four.
Turns out the last six months of "coming home" was just them fattening up my heart for harvest.
What they don't know? The voice memo on my phone caught everything.
What they really don't know? Six months from now, I'm coming back—
With a Dark Moon Alliance badge. And a heart much colder than the one they stole.
Shh. Listen.
That stolen heart? It's starting to reject.

title: Obsessive Devotion
desc: Chloe, a young jewelry designer, is devastated when her husband Ethan falls into a coma after an accident. Strangely, Ethan's brother Aiden, who was also in the accident, wakes up with mannerisms, actions, and habits identical to Ethan's. It seems as if Ethan's "soul" has taken over Aiden, who knows every detail of Chloe's life with Ethan. Torn and confused, Chloe struggles to accept this unexpected twist of fate...

title: Crashed, Cheated, Caught
desc:
Three years after my pilot husband "died" in a plane crash, I walk in on him cutting a birthday cake for his three-year-old son backstage at the company memorial gala.
Luke freezes in the lounge, his hand still on the knife, staring at me.
His parents rush over to shield him. The same couple who screamed at me in the funeral home, wishing I'd died instead of him.
"Nora, just calm down. There's an explanation..."
Claire covers her slightly rounded belly, tears streaming down her face. "I'm so sorry, Nora. My baby needs his father. Please, I'm begging you. I couldn't help myself—I love him."
I thought I'd break down. Thought I'd scream.
But all that guilt, all that self-blame, three years of missing him burns away the second I see the truth.
Nothing's left.

title: Marrying My Jerk Ex's Dad
desc: Grace accidentally slept with Andrew and was wracked with guilt over betraying her boyfriend. But then she found out that her boyfriend had been cheating on her with her best friend. In a fit of rage, Grace married Andrew, without a clue about who he really was...

title: Trial Marriage To A Billionaire Season 2
cleanTitle: Trial Marriage To A Billionaire Season 2
desc:
In the gripping second season, the aftermath of Logan's scandalous affair with Grace continues to ripple through the lives of everyone involved. Logan, compelled by his 
mistress’s unexpected pregnancy, finally decides to abandon his fiancée, Aurora, choosing to embrace a tumultuous relationship with Grace. As Grace leverages her pregnancy to control Logan, their volatile bond reveals cracks as they navigate the complexities of love, betrayal, and ambition. Meanwhile, Aurora, now finding solace in her successful career, refuses to expose her relationship with Mason—a secret she protects fiercely from the prying eyes of the entertainment industry. Thriving in this new luxury lifestyle, she begins to draw the attention of fans and critics alike, sparking jealousy within Logan as he grapples with the consequences of his choices...

title: Her Silent Brilliance
desc: Sherry Dawson, who suffers from aphasia, is forced to marry Regis Quinn, the son of the richest man in town, to save her bankrupted family. Soon, she discovers the Quinns are connected to her mother's death. Bound by a marriage contract, Sherry and Regis start out wary of each other, but gradually build trust as they work together to uncover the truth. Their investigation reveals that the mastermind is actually Regis's older brother, Hugh, whom Regis has always admired. Years ago, Hugh killed Sherry’s mother to seize the family fortune, faked a disability, and manipulated Regis ever since. In the end, Sherry regains her voice, and together with Regis, exposes Hugh's schemes and finds true love.

title: Mr. Brayden's Jealous
desc: Bella's life is a storm of misfortune, from her father's gambling addiction to her brother's hospitalization. As Brayden Asor’s secretary—and secret lover—she harbors a shocking secret: she's just a stand-in. Can love transcend deception and disparity?

title: All Schemes Come to Nothing
desc:
"Ethan Gould and Siofra Yeats maintained a seven-year platonic marriage, only for Ethan to discover that Siofra had an affair with her HIV-positive assistant, Morgan, and became pregnant. Siofra remained stubborn, smashed the cure, and was swindled out of three billion dollars. In the end, both she and her child contracted HIV, and Yeats Group teetered on the brink of bankruptcy.
 With the help of his schoolmate, Sydney, Ethan managed to reclaim control of Gould Corp and began a new chapter with Sydney. Meanwhile, Siofra, Morgan and the others spiraled into ruin, undone by betrayal and illness."

title: After Being Stood Up Nineteen Times, I Walked Away
cleanTitle: After Being Stood Up Nineteen Times, I Walked Away
desc:
Nineteen times. That's how many times Lucas promised to marry me, only to leave me standing alone because of her.
Today was supposed to be our day. But as I stood in the biting cold outside the restaurant, watching him carefully help Selena into his Maybach, the marriage application still tucked in my purse, I finally understood—that "someday" would never come.
"Let's reschedule the registration, okay?" he'd said without even looking at me.
I walked straight to HR and submitted my resignation. Then I accepted the offer from the Morinetti family—his sworn enemies.
As I boarded my flight to the West Coast, my phone exploded with messages.
"We agreed to go to City Hall today. Where are you?"
I glanced at the screen one last time, then powered it off.
"We're done."

title: The Setup: Prof's Gambit
desc: Elite attorney Wanda accidentally uncovers her husband Shane's affair with his student Yvonne while reviewing home security footage in search of a document. As a seasoned lawyer, Wanda keeps her composure and doesn't confront them right away. Instead, she quietly gathers evidence of their affair and their abuse of power for personal gain. Turning the tables, Wanda invites Yvonne into their home under the pretense of helping her study for the bar exam, deliberately allowing the two to continue crossing the line right under her nose. Meanwhile, she teams up with her journalist friend Willa, setting a carefully orchestrated trap and tightening the net step by step. Determined to make the betrayers pay, Wanda launches a high-stakes game of revenge, where intelligence is her sharpest weapon.

title: My Ex-Wife, My Doctor
desc: After two years of marriage to Daniel Foster, Chloe Kelly had endured constant provocations from the "old mistress." Once she saw through her husband's cold indifference, she didn't hesitate—she slapped the divorce papers on the table and walked away. Daniel scoffed at first, thinking she was just being dramatic and would come crawling back soon enough. He had no idea Chloe would return to her medical roots and quickly rise to fame as a renowned men's health specialist. As for the mistress Daniel always thought of as his "savior," Jess Wever turned out to be an academic fraud in every sense—her credentials were fake, and she'd been lying to Daniel for years. By the time Daniel came groveling back, Chloe was already making waves in the men's clinic. She picked up her acupuncture needles with a smirk. "Need a treatment too, ex?"

title: His Unknown Wife
desc:
"Gifted with extraordinary talent, Zoe Allen originally wanted to build a name for herself at home. But her ex-boyfriend, empowered by his family's influence, refused to leave her alone. With no other choice, Zoe was forced to leave the country, even if it meant walking away from her new husband, Theo Kane.
Relying on her talent and relentless hard work, she rose to become one of the world's top designers. Always private and cautious, she hid her identity behind the alias Luna.
All the while, to make up for leaving Theo behind, Zoe quietly supported the growth and success of his company from the shadows. With her exceptional ability and striking beauty, she attracted no shortage of admirers. Among them, Julian Frost, heir to the global luxury powerhouse DK Group, pursued her with relentless devotion and stayed by her side overseas. But Zoe remained unmoved, her heart still set on her husband.
After achieving fame and success, Zoe returned home full of hope, ready to finally live a happy life with Theo. Instead, she discovered that Theo had been cheating on her with Vivian, a fellow designer. Worse still, Vivian had been using Luna's name to deceive others and build her own reputation.
What hurt Zoe most was that the husband she had never stopped caring about had no idea that it was his own wife who had been supporting him in secret all along.
After getting rich, Theo became arrogant. He proposed a divorce, lashed out at Zoe with cruel words, and treated her with contempt. Proud and strong-willed, Zoe walked away without hesitation. Even after losing Zoe's support, Theo continued to show off, claiming that he had secured design authorization from Luna. But at the critical moment, Zoe exposed him. Backed into a corner, Vivian finally admitted that she was not Luna at all. Theo was left stunned, and the entire Kane Group collapsed in scandal and financial ruin. Vivian was arrested and sent to prison.
In the end, Zoe revealed that she was the real Luna. And under Theo's devastated, regret-filled gaze, she accepted Julian Frost's proposal."

title: The Three-Year Lie
desc:
"I stayed in another world for Ethan, hiding his infertility and enduring IVF alone. The day I found out I was pregnant, I caught him at a prenatal check-up with his ""true love."" Heartbroken, my system awakened, and I left, taking our child with me.

Back in the real world, I focused on my career and fell in love with my childhood friend. Obsessed, Ethan chased after me, but my heart was already cold. Eventually, I exposed his true love's fake pregnancy, saw his family go bankrupt, and found happiness with my childhood sweetheart.

""Some loves, even the system deems unworthy of a second chance."""

title: Every Time She Prayed, My Baby Died
cleanTitle: Every Time She Prayed, My Baby Died
desc:
Three years of marriage. Three pregnancies.
Every time I confirmed I was pregnant, my sister-in-law Ophelia would walk into the chapel behind the manor.
Then my in-laws would drag me to the hospital and force me to abort the healthy baby.
The night after my third miscarriage, I dragged my weakened body to follow her into the chapel.
The moment I pushed open that door, my blood ran cold.
In that instant, I finally understood why my three children had to die.

title: （Dubbed）The Double Life of My Mysterious CEO
cleanTitle: （Dubbed）The Double Life of My Mysterious CEO
desc: Emily Rain, drugged by her boss who owed her back wages, to get her money back,and married her swimming instructor, Alex Smith. Her life took a dramatic turn: she won a design competition and became a renowned jewelry designer for MP. She credited her success to hard work and luck, only to later discover that her husband was actually the CEO of MP.

title: Remarried for Revenge
desc:
"Valerie Summer, a top fashion designer, discovers that her fiancé, Miles Luke, is cheating on her with her best friend, Callie Lane. Worse, Callie steals her designs and enters them in a competition under her own name. Determined to get revenge, Valerie enters into a contract marriage with Evan Guthrie, the CEO of the Guthrie Group.
 After their whirlwind marriage, the two work seamlessly together, driving Miles's Skyline Group into a steep decline. In the end, Evan acquires it for a fraction of its value. Along the way, Valerie and Evan's relationship quietly shifts from a marriage of convenience into a real and lasting love."

title: Starry Fragments
desc: After being abandoned in the wild by the Sharps to steal her luck, Marlene Sharp was taken in by Michael the Whole of the Magic Academy. Years later, having mastered the mystical arts, she left the academy to fulfill her destiny: to find her fated one, Shane James, and marry him as part of her Trial. At that time, Shane was gravely ill and on the verge of being overthrown by his younger brother, Chase. In a critical moment, Marlene appeared and married Shane in a flash wedding, using her powers to dispel the evil spirit threatening his life. Only then was the crisis temporarily resolved.

title: When Hearts Ring
desc: An adorable sign language translator and a cold, aloof lawyer—a loveless married couple in an arranged marriage for three years, distant on the surface but hiding deep feelings for each other!

title: Mr. Sterling's Fiery Sweetheart
desc: Seven years ago, Grace stumbled mistakenly into the hotel room of Damien, the enigmatic CEO of Sterling Group. That one passionate night resulted in twin boys. In a cruel twist of fate, her eldest son was stolen and abandoned, leaving only little Leo by her side. Fast forward seven years, and Grace returns home with Leo, determined to find her lost son. When she unexpectedly crosses paths with Damien once more, sparks fly, but neither recognizes the other... What will happen when the truth comes to light?

title: Do Not Deceive Me
desc: Iris Clark, a corporate employee, falls in love with her junior worker, Miles Walker, who belongs to a lower-class background. Iris convinces her family to let her marry Miles. Despite much disapproval, she finally gets consent from her family to marry him. Just three months into their marriage, Iris wins an unexpected millionaire jackpot. For safety purposes, Iris transfers the amount to her husband's account, but soon, she is faced with cold behavior by Miles. He began ignoring her and lying to her. Iris saw her marriage breaking apart, but before she could do anything with her funds, Miles announced a divorce. Iris tries to get her money back from him, but Miles influences everyone she goes for help. Worse was that Iris' sister, Katie Clark was behind the master plan...

title: She's the Real Pearl
desc: From billionaire to humble teacher—Richard Collins, Northwood's richest man, quietly molds his beloved daughter into success. But when she refuses to ghostwrite a paper for the dean's daughter, all hell breaks loose. Public humiliation in the bathroom, a humiliating livestream prank, and even having her clothes ripped off while false rumors swirl—all to test Richard's limits. The final blow? It's struck by someone from his own circle. When the truth explodes, the tables turn in a jaw-dropping identity reveal. Love and pride collide in an epic showdown—witness what happens when you mess with his daughter: "Cross her, and I'll flip the whole world upside down!"

title: One Night, One Forever
desc: Lila Carter, a 24-year-old waitress from a modest background, is trying to find her footing in life. After a particularly rough breakup, she goes out for a drink at a local bar and meets Ethan Grayson, a wealthy and charismatic billionaire. One night of passion leads to unexpected consequences. Lila discovers she’s pregnant. Fearing the reaction of her strict and overbearing mother, Vivian, Lila keeps the pregnancy a secret. But the weight of her decision begins to take a toll. After a month of stress, guilt, and a barrage of verbal abuse from her mother, Lila is forced to confront her past and reveals the pregnancy to Ethan. In their marriage, the tension is palpable. Ethan continues his relationship with Sophia Blake, a glamorous but manipulative influencer, while Lila struggles to adjust to her new life as a wife to a man who doesn’t want her. As the months pass and Lila’s pregnancy progresses, Ethan finds himself torn. His initial bitterness fades as he begins to see Lila not as a golddigger but as a strong, independent woman with a heart of gold. The way she lovingly cares for their unborn child and the resilience she shows in the face of adversity draw Ethan closer to her...

title: Echoes of a Hollow City
desc: This is a story of gratitude, betrayal, and growth set in the world of corporate intrigue and romance. Edward secretly assists Jessica in running Starlight Entertainment, elevating it over five years. Villainous Ethan creates misunderstandings, causing Jessica to repeatedly hurt Edward until he leaves. When the company faces a crisis, Edward returns to help, but whether he forgives Jessica remains a mystery.

title: Help! I'm Falling In Love With My Rude CEO
cleanTitle: Help! I'm Falling In Love With My Rude CEO
desc: Hailey Adams becomes the secretary of the rude CEO Mason Anderson. No one else would take the job as Mason had fired five secretaries in a month. Other employees bet on how long she'll last, and when Hailey finds out, she's determined to stay. Mason constantly criticizes her. After a breakdown, Hailey transforms her look and attitude, stunning everyone. Mason's jealous girlfriend, Scarlett, tries to frame Hailey for leaking company info. Mason calls the police, but later learns the truth and breaks up with Scarlett. He apologizes to Hailey and compensates her. Hailey quits but agrees to accompany him to visit his ill mother. There, they grow closer. Back at work, they realize they have feelings for each other. However, Scarlett returns, claiming to be pregnant. Eventually, they find out it's a fake. The story ends with Mason planning a surprise proposal party for Hailey with the help of the employees...

title: The Wife's Calculated Move
desc: Betrayed by his wife and her lover, and murdered by his own son, Daniel is given a second chance at life. Back from the brink, he's out for vengeance—determined to make his enemies pay in blood. With cunning traps and shocking reveals, Daniel exposes the web of lies, turning greed against itself. As his betrayers fall into ruin, Daniel finds hope and a new beginning with the one person who truly cares. This time, he's taking control of his destiny—no one will stand in his way.

title: After My Bestie Slept With My Ex-Husband
cleanTitle: After My Bestie Slept With My Ex-Husband
desc: Her idyllic life shatters when she discovers her husband’s betrayal with her best friend—and their deadly plot to kill her. Rescued and empowered by a secret admirer, she executes a stunning plan of revenge.

title: （Dubbed）Abyss of Desire
desc:
Emily Carter is renowned throughout Westbridge University. A top academic achiever with exceptional beauty, yet from an impoverished background. For someone like her, her appearance isn't a blessing—it's original sin.

Alex Lowell was born at the pinnacle of the social pyramid. With his privileged family background and flawless appearance, he has everything—yet he's an absolute scoundrel.

These two people from entirely different worlds, who should have no connection whatsoever, were one day caught in an unexpected situation:

In Alex's Aston Martin, Emily was seen lifted with one arm onto his lap, her back pressed against the steering wheel. Through the interplay of light and shadow through the car windows, the man's pale, refined profile was clearly visible as he held her wrist, personally teaching her how to loosen his...

title: His Light in the Dark
desc: Andrologist Tessa Tilden marries Jordan Slate to save her mother—only to be ensnared in a web of family intrigue. On their wedding night, she encounters Simon Slate, discovering later that he is Jordan's alternate persona, born from a childhood trauma seventeen years ago. As Tessa unravels the kidnapping plot behind it all, she and Jordan join forces to expose his uncle Marcel Slate and restore both love and peace to the Slate family.

title: （Dubbed）Marrying My Jerk Ex's Dad
desc: Grace accidentally slept with Andrew and was wracked with guilt over betraying her boyfriend. But then she found out that her boyfriend had been cheating on her with her best friend. In a fit of rage, Grace married Andrew, without a clue about who he really was...

title: I Slept with My Three  Stepsons
cleanTitle: I Slept with My Three  Stepsons
desc: A young girl hits rock bottom in a single day: her father dies, her boyfriend runs off with her best friend, and she’s condemned as a curse by her own pack. Just as they’re ready to burn her, the powerful Reven Pack declares her the destined Luna. To survive, she marries an old Alpha—who dies instantly. Now the elders say she must choose a new husband from his three sons, and whoever she picks becomes the next Alpha… or both packs will fall. Three heirs. One Luna. A deadly race for power—and her heart.

title: （DUBBED）The Pinnacle Club
desc: Bella and her sister Molly have always relied on each other. Molly's future looked bright with her plans to study abroad, but everything came crashing down when she fell naked to her death from the Sterling Corporation building. The brutal truth? The chairman raped her, and his son pushed her. Yet, thanks to their immense power, the Sterlings walked free, the case ruled an accident. Devastated, Bella vows to take them down, only to be manipulated by Ethan, the chairman's illegitimate son, who sees her as the perfect weapon against his own family. Thrust into a world of wealth and dark secrets, Bella uses her rage to fuel family infighting. But as sparks fly between her and Ethan, and just when she thinks she's achieved her revenge, she realizes the real storm is only just beginning…

title: Starlight with No Way Back
desc:
"Shiloh Tanner was born into poverty. She fought her way into university through her own hard work, only to be manipulated and threatened by her mother and younger brother, who treated her like their personal ATM and drained everything they could from her.
By chance, she took a job at a boxing gym and met Asher Church there. When Asher realized Shiloh was his underclassman from university, he stepped in to help her. But then Shiloh’s mother threatened and pressured her to come up with $100,000. Asher had originally only meant to scare Shiloh a little, to teach her that men in the outside world were never as decent as they seemed. Instead, driven into a corner by her family, Shiloh unexpectedly took the initiative and came to him.
After they spent the night together, Asher mistakenly assumed she really was the kind of girl who cared only about money. Later, he accidentally overheard a phone call between Shiloh and her mother and finally realized he had misunderstood her.
One day, Asher's friend, James, invited Asher out for drinks. Asher knew the bar James mentioned was Phantom Lounge, where Shiloh worked, and for reasons he couldn’t quite explain, he went. There, he ran into his cousin Zeke bullying Shiloh. Asher stepped in, saved her, and took her home.
It was the first time Asher had ever met a girl who was so easy to pick on and so painfully naive, and before he knew it, he had developed a complicated fascination with her. After carefully probing into her family situation, Asher told her he could protect her and help her break free from them—if she stayed with him.
Shiloh refused and tried to leave in a hurry, but then her mother called and threatened her again, this time demanding $200,000. Asher said bluntly that they could do it again—something between two consenting adults. Shiloh hated herself for sinking to the point of trading her body like this, but she had no other choice. Asher comforted her, telling her she had done nothing wrong, that it was consensual, and urged her to relax.
The next morning, just as Shiloh was about to leave, Asher’s fiancée showed up at the door."

title: Game Of Choice
desc:
Welcome to the cruel game of money and family! A fierce quarrel separated single mother Eve from her rebellious daughter Vicky. As night falls, Vicky mysteriously disappears, and Eve is forced to step into Eden Island - a death game with family ties at stake.
Here, every breath could be the last. The contestants fight each other to save their loved ones! To save her daughter, Eve will do whatever it takes...

title: My Fox Spirit Wife
desc: Hank was born as the Fate's Favored, a man blessed with ordinary luck. Under his influence, his girlfriend Hannah saw her career flourish and rise higher and higher. Then, by chance, Hank crossed paths with a fox spirit—and from that moment on, his life was never the same.

title: The Wife's Deadly Temptation
desc: Renee Lane was betrayed by her husband, who got involved with her best friend and even plotted to kill her to seize the Lane Group. She later returns under the new name Remy Lang to take revenge.

title: The True Heiress Strikes Back
desc:
"Switched at birth. Framed for Clara's crime. Eleanor spent three years in prison only to return to her family celebrating Clara's birthday.​
She just smiled and began her game—out-scheming the schemer, humiliating every enemy, clawing her way to the top. Just as Clara thought she'd won, the most powerful man in Imperial City stepped forward to claim Eleanor as his.
That's when Clara realized: the pushover heiress was gone. In her place stood a hunter.
— Did you think I was just the real heiress you could push around? No. I came back to judge you all."

title: Mr. Vance's Lost Body
desc: It's a corporate showdown, a family feud, a fierce brotherly battle for inheritance, and a high-stakes economic duel among tycoons. But when a freak soul swap turns their world upside down, the fight for family dominance explodes like never before...

title: (DUBBED)Back to the 80s: Making My Fortune
desc: Wealthy hairdressing mogul Amelia accidentally time-travels to the 1980s, becoming the neighborhood "nuisance." Her scientist husband Luke originally wanted a divorce but was always refused. Now, it's Amelia who's determined to leave him. As she focuses on making money, Luke pleads with her, saying, "If we get divorced, where will I find a wife as good as you?"

title: （Dubbed）My Mercy Ends Here
desc:
She hid her true identity and married him for three years, secretly clearing every obstacle in his business path.​
Until he forcibly took her blood to save his old flame—she handed him divorce papers and vanished without a trace.​
After the divorce, he finally discovered that the lifesaver he'd been searching for and the business benefactor behind his success were none other than the "ex-wife" he'd cast aside.​
At her engagement party, as he begged in utter disgrace, she simply raised her glass with a knowing smile:​
"Mr. Miller, your precious first love is waiting for you… in prison."

title: （DUBBED）His Light in the Dark
desc:
"Cecilia, a dedicated urologist, marries into the powerful Russell family to save her sick mother, becoming the wife of Aiden, Emerald City's richest man. On their wedding night, she encounters Aiden's enigmatic younger brother, Austin. Torn between Aiden's cold demeanor and Austin's gentle nature, Cecilia soon uncovers a shocking truth: Austin is actually a manifestation of Aiden's split personality, rooted in a traumatic kidnapping incident from seventeen years ago.
As Cecilia digs deeper, she discovers that Aiden's uncle, Simon, was involved in the kidnapping. Together, she and Aiden confront Simon, work through Aiden's trauma, and help integrate his fractured identities. Through their journey of healing and redemption, they rekindle love, overcome their crises, and restore peace to the Russell family."

title: Dead Man's Revenge
desc:
"Felix Lynch, gravely ill, unexpectedly discovers that his wife, Victoria, is not only having an affair, but is also plotting with her lover to seize his entire inheritance and even sell their daughter.
 With only one month left to live, Felix has no choice but to use the little time he has left to set a trap—one that will make both of them, especially Victoria, who holds inheritance rights and legal custody of their daughter, disappear for good.
 Weakened by his illness, Felix turns to Snow, a woman who shares a common enemy with him, and brings her in as his partner to help carry out this deadly plan."

title: (DUBBED)Diamond Darling:Sweet Pregnancy Love
desc: A Baby, A Billionaire And Me. After an unexpected encounter, Sophie Gray gives birth to a son, Tommy Gray, changing her life forever. Six years later, Lucas Lind learns about the child he never knew existed and sets out to find him. As fate brings them closer, Sophie starts working at Lind Corp, where her relationship with Lucas deepens, and love begins to grow between them.

title: Why I Did It
desc: Tired of her boring job and in need of a fresh start, Zoe moves back to the city she grew up in. The plan was to get a new job, meet somebody and bring back a spark in her life. She meets Mr. Gregory on a solo night out in the city and ends up in his bed. Unknowingly to her, that innocent hookup was about to change her life and bring back that spark she was looking for, but not in a good way. She bumps into an old friend, Sophia and they become very close only for Zoe to find out the man she slept with is her friend's husband. Things get more interesting when she finds a journal which belongs to her missing brother Andrew who is a journalist...

title: Raising a Reckless Disciple
desc:
"Joe was Sage's chosen heir, though he knew nothing of his identity and continued living quietly at Serenity Academy.
 At the same time, the Moores came under attack. The Moore sisters fled for their lives and, by chance, crossed paths with Joe during recruitment before joining under his wing.
 Juliet Moore was reckless by nature, and her understanding of Holy Scriptures was often wildly off the mark. Yet somehow, through a string of absurd accidents, her cultivation surged right along with those misunderstandings.
 Later, when demonic cultivators caught up to them, Juliet suppressed them with ease."

title: My Silent Farewell
desc:
Diana is finally reunited with her wealthy biological parents after years in an orphanage, expecting a life of happiness.

Instead, she discovers Wendy, their beloved fake daughter who will stop at nothing to maintain her place.

Wendy's schemes reach a terrifying level when she frames Diana by pushing her fiancé's sister down the stairs, leaving her in a coma.

In court, Diana's parents delete crucial footage and her brother falsely testifies, sending her to prison for five brutal years.

Released and determined to cut ties, she's hardened, ready to leave them forever.

But now, her family suddenly wants her back...

title: My Sunset Love After with the Billionaire CEO
cleanTitle: My Sunset Love After with the Billionaire CEO
desc: Former Name：My sunset love affair with the billionaire CEO ；Middle-aged Jennifer has lost everything! She joins a romance reality show, Diamond Bachelor, trying to get through her predicament, and meets a CEO in disguise, Paul Marshall. He is drawn to Jennifer's kindness and independence, which leads to the two getting married in an instant. Paul wants to come clean, but afraid that he could lose Jennifer, he has no choice but keep his identity a secret while spoiling Jennifer to no end. However, his big secret is on the verge of coming to light

title: (DUBBED)Twilight Surge
desc: A car accident shatters Sophia's perfect life: her daughter goes missing, and her husband Ethan becomes erratic. Convinced he's hiding something, Sophia begins a secret investigation. Sixteen years later, as Windsor Corporation plans to develop Willow Creek Hollow, Ethan's odd behavior intensifies. Determined to uncover the truth, Sophia travels to the mysterious village alone. There, the accident's real cause, her daughter's fate, and Ethan's secrets will finally come to light...

title: Our Forever Started Long Ago
desc: When Jayden Fuller was young, he hated studying—until his mother hired Nancy Quinn to look after him. Her admirable qualities inspired him to become disciplined, and he secretly vowed to marry her one day. Years later, now the world's richest man, the first thing Jayden does after achieving everything is to return to the countryside and make his promise

title: Two Worlds Apart
desc: In a world divided by wealth and privilege, two baby girls are unknowingly switched at birth, each raised in the life intended for the other. On one side is Isabella, a spirited young woman who grows up with every luxury imaginable, unaware that her family’s vast fortune is not rightfully hers. Raised by her wealthy “father,” Mr. Donovan, and groomed to embody poise and elegance, Isabella is engaged to Adrian, a charming, ambitious man who seems to complete her picture-perfect life. On the other side is Elena, raised in poverty by her loving yet struggling “father,” Mr. Martinez. A grounded and hardworking young woman, Elena works as a janitor in Donovan Industries, the very company owned by her real family. Despite her modest circumstances, Elena carries an innate sense of sophistication and resilience that draws people to her.Their worlds collide when Elena crosses paths with Adrian, Isabella’s fiancé. A chance encounter sparks a connection between them, challenging Adrian’s loyalty and drawing him toward the quiet strength and authenticity that Elena possesses. As the secrets begin to unravel, Adrian’s feelings lead him to discover the truth behind Isabella and Elena’s past...

title: Mocked by My Wife
desc: To help make his wife's dream of becoming an influencer come true, Bryan Zeller, the president of internet giant Keystone Group, disguises himself as a lowly security guard and stays by Sophie Scott's side while she builds her career. On their wedding anniversary, he plans to surprise her with a billion-dollar contract as a gift. But instead, his sweet influencer wife Sophie turns around and climbs into James Cole's luxury car—then ends up trending across the platform with him. When Bryan goes to confront them, Sophie and James shower him with mockery and insults, all because they think he's nothing more than a security guard.

title: （Dubbed）Off-Screen Lovers
desc: Anna Charles  and Leon Grantk enter a sham marriage after Jack Moss's car accident, concealing their true feelings. As they work together on set, honesty begins to blend with affection. Eventually, secrets are uncovered, misunderstandings are healed, and they reach a heartfelt ending sealed by true love.

title: （Dubbed）My Flash-Marriage Bride
desc: Molly marries the comatose Alexander to save her gravely ill grandmother, despite neither of them knowing each other. Eight months later, struggling to make ends meet while pregnant, Molly encounters Alexander again while delivering takeout. Unbeknownst to him, he starts to develop feelings for her. With a little push from his grandmother, they finally recognize each other. Molly gives birth to beautiful twins, and she and Alexander find lasting happiness together.

title: My Flash-Marriage Bride
desc: Molly marries the comatose Alexander to save her gravely ill grandmother, despite neither of them knowing each other. Eight months later, struggling to make ends meet while pregnant, Molly encounters Alexander again while delivering takeout. Unbeknownst to him, he starts to develop feelings for her. With a little push from his grandmother, they finally recognize each other. Molly gives birth to beautiful twins, and she and Alexander find lasting happiness together.

title: （Dubbed）You Are My One and Only
desc: After being diagnosed with cancer, Aurora makes a life-changing decision to divorce her unloving husband. One drunken night, she ends up in a passionate fling with Charles, the heir to the Harrison family. This ignites a tumultuous love story filled with drama, passion, and intense romance as Charles fights to win her heart...

title: Undercover as a Deliveryman
desc:
"Ryan Grant, heir to a legendary martial master, became the live-in son-in-law of the Lewis family as a nobody, taking a job as a delivery driver to experience the full range of ordinary life. When his training was finally complete and his martial arts reached perfection, he stood against the Overlords to defend the nation's security, earning glory that would never be forgotten.
 But the Lewis family valued wealth over character and ultimately turned their backs on him. The Sheen family, meanwhile, threw their weight around and bullied Ryan without restraint. Ryan answered with an iron hand, punishing evil, helping the innocent, and upholding what was right."

title: Bringing Home a Rented Boyfriend
desc:
"Yvette Lewis was the only daughter in her family, and everyone in the extended clan looked down on her. They thought it was disgraceful that at twenty-five she still wasn't married, had no money, and insisted on working out of town.
 Then Yvette hit the lottery.
 With a casual wave of her hand, she decided to rent a boyfriend to bring home for the New Year. That's when she met Jason Boone.
 Jason mistook Yvette for a blind date his mother had arranged. Just like that, he climbed into her car and got hauled straight back to her hometown.
 Yvette assumed Jason came from a dirt-poor family and his parents had forced him into this line of work—boyfriend rental. The moment they arrived, her aunts and distant relatives swarmed them with questions. Yvette fired back with cool comebacks to each one.
 Her cousin Megan showed up with her own boyfriend, and everyone immediately started comparing him to Jason, saying Yvette and Jason were broke losers who couldn't make it in life.
 Jason spoke up boldly, claiming the gifts he'd brought were just as good, if not better.
 That night, Yvette slapped down a million bucks in front of Jason. ""Buy whatever you want. Just say you bought it yourself."" She promised she'd have his back.
 Jason was genuinely touched. He stepped outside to call his assistant and have him prepare some serious gifts.
 When he came back, the two accidentally kissed. Jason's heart fluttered a little, but Yvette just said, ""Do I need to pay extra for that?""
 The next day at the family estate, Yvette got ambushed again by the elders lecturing her. Megan made a grand entrance with her boyfriend, bragging that she'd brought five hundred thousand dollars' worth of gifts, mocking Yvette and Jason.
 Jason grabbed Yvette's hand and told her to snap her fingers.
 Yvette snapped with style.
 A swarm of bodyguards and assistants flooded into the courtyard, each one carrying different luxury gifts, shutting everyone up. Over time, through various small incidents, Jason found himself drawn to Yvette's quirky charm. He stepped in to help her put her relatives in their place, and even helped out around her family's place—feeding chickens, slopping pigs, chopping firewood. During a private conversation between Jason and his assistant, Megan accidentally overheard them. She discovered their relationship was fake—and that Jason was loaded.
 Consumed with jealousy, Megan schemed to frame Yvette. Luckily, Jason arrived just in time to save the day.
 Meanwhile, Jason's mother heard that her son had already met the in-laws and rushed over to meet them herself.
 After Jason's identity was exposed, Yvette tried to bolt, but Jason caught her. ""We already kissed. You think you can just walk away without taking responsibility?""
 In the end, they both fell for each other and ended up together."

title: Good For Him
desc: Ava Dickson, beautiful, calculative and some might say cold, fought to win the heart of Adam Hart. Using her father's influence and money, she helps Adam build one of the biggest Shipping companies in the world. Ava's only request to Adam is that he remain faithful and committed to her even though she knows his heart once belonged to Ella Madden. Ella still waits for Adam to come back to her, and she takes her chance when the opportunity presents itself.Adam believes that he can and will only love Ella, even if Ava's father managed to convince him to marry his daughter. But a chance meeting with Ella reignites old feelings and soon, a romance ensues. They try hard to keep their secret relationship from Ava. Their once beautiful romance produced a child which Adam kept hidden from Ava successfully.Things spiral out of control when Ava finally learns the truth. Will Ava turn the other cheek and forgive Adam for his temporal weakness accepting his other family, or will Adam finally leave Ava and be with the love of his life.
