The twists and turns of this drama series ask, what if the bad guy wins? Will there be a happily ever after? I guess we have to stay tuned to find out.

title: A Recipe for Revenge
desc: Master Chef Grace was murdered and reborn as the stand-in for CEO Charles's beloved. She hid her talent, but her incredible culinary skills couldn't stay a secret for long. When their contract ended, she turned to leave, but the cold, stoic man cornered her, his eyes burning with emotion. "The taste... I know it's you," he said. This time, she's determined to reclaim not only her title as a Master Chef, but also the life stolen by her backstabbing friend and ex-boyfriend.

title: （Dubbed）Kill Me, Save Me
desc: After his girlfriend Emily King's tragic death, Noah Stark loses his sanity. He feigns recovery upon release from the hospital, carefully setting a web of revenge and turning Jerry Fox and Jade White against each other. When the truth comes to light, he faces justice—the cost he willingly pays for the love of his life.

title: Billionaire’s Betrayal
desc: Anya Petrova, a brilliant heiress seeking revenge against billionaire Damien Blackwood, infiltrates his inner circle under a false identity. She plans to ruin his reputation and business empire, as Blackwood's actions have led to the downfall of her family. However, as her plans unfold, Anya finds herself unexpectedly drawn to Damien. Despite her initial disdain for him, she is captivated by his charm and intelligence. Their forbidden romance is complicated by their families' bitter rivalry and the secrets of their pasts. Anya must navigate between her desire for justice and her growing feelings for Damien...

title: From Zero, Her Plea
desc:
"Tech mogul Daniel Lewis was poisoned by his sister Emily and her boyfriend Jason, only to be reborn at the critical moment of his father's terminal illness and the impending inheritance division. Facing his equally reborn, power-hungry sister Emily, he deliberately ceded control of Lewis Innovations—riddled with financial loopholes—taking only his father's entrepreneurial journal. Using insights from the journal and memories from his past life, Daniel traded stocks to raise seed capital, rapidly growing Cosmos Technologies and catching the attention of investment queen Diana Sterling, who soon became a key partner.
 Meanwhile, Emily struggled to steer Lewis Innovations toward success. After stealing Daniel’s plans for The Everest Project, she fell right into his trap. Through clashes at tech expos and financing meetings, Daniel outmaneuvered her at every turn, igniting a high-stakes battle over family assets, cutting-edge projects, and long-simmering revenge."

title: Twilight Surge
desc: A car accident shatters Sophia's perfect life: her daughter goes missing, and her husband Ethan becomes erratic. Convinced he's hiding something, Sophia begins a secret investigation. Sixteen years later, as Windsor Corporation plans to develop Willow Creek Hollow, Ethan's odd behavior intensifies. Determined to uncover the truth, Sophia travels to the mysterious village alone. There, the accident's real cause, her daughter's fate, and Ethan's secrets will finally come to light...

title: （Dubbed）My Silent Farewell
desc:
Diana is finally reunited with her wealthy biological parents after years in an orphanage, expecting a life of happiness.
Instead, she discovers Wendy, their beloved fake daughter who will stop at nothing to maintain her place.
Wendy's schemes reach a terrifying level when she frames Diana by pushing her fiancé's sister down the stairs, leaving her in a coma.
In court, Diana's parents delete crucial footage and her brother falsely testifies, sending her to prison for five brutal years.Released and determined to cut ties, she's hardened, ready to leave them forever.
But now, her family suddenly wants her back...

title: One Moon for Two Homes
desc:
"On the night of her wedding, Autumn discovers that her husband, Dawson, and her mother-in-law, Lana, are planning to sell her. Determined to escape, she begins fighting for her freedom. Along the way, she forms a deep bond with her stepdaughter, Luna. Tragically, Luna is killed while trying to save Autumn.
 Despite repeated failed escape attempts and being imprisoned more than once, Autumn eventually proves her innocence and, with the help of the villagers, breaks free from Dawson's control. Throughout it all, she uses her wits to protect herself, including pretending to be pregnant and working with her senior schoolmate, Snow, who was also trafficked into the town. Facing relentless threats from Dawson and his family, Autumn shows extraordinary courage and intelligence. In the end, she not only ensures the villains receive the punishment they deserve, but also successfully divorces Dawson and begins a new life for herself."

title: Father and Son: The Dragon’s Rivalry
cleanTitle: Father and Son: The Dragon’s Rivalry
desc: In the concrete jungle of the city, former world champion Damian hides, burdened by the tragic loss of his wife and his own crippling injury. Twelve years later, a new dark force emerges, and his son Leo becomes an unwilling pawn in a deadly game. Will Damian rise again to fight for his family and honor against long-standing hatred and conspiracy? This is a tale packed with suspense and emotion, where power, deceit, and family collide at every turn. Join us to uncover the truth and witness the fearless comeback of a legendary fighter.

title: Fired the Wrong Man
desc:
"Tyler Scott, a brilliant bridge designer, was personally recruited by the chairman of James Corp after repeated invitations to join the company as Chief Engineer. He played a key role in elevating James Corp to the top of the industry, only to be unexpectedly fired by the chairman's daughter, Sienna.
 After leaving James Corp, Tyler joined its rival, Hightide Realty, where he used his expertise to help the company strike back and bring James Corp down."

title: After the Classics Were Lost
desc: In this world, the thread of civilization has been severed. Nations' histories and cultures vanished into the distant past, and people can only piece them back together little by little through archaeology. Evan Cole is transmigrated into this world and becomes a food delivery guy. While delivering an order to the Institute of Classical Studies, he completes the full poem "Sonnet 18," shocking everyone present. Professor Philip personally leads a team to apologize and make amends. At the same time, while out making deliveries, Evan unexpectedly discovers his girlfriend cheating on him. A fierce confrontation breaks out, and Evan once again reveals his astonishing mastery of traditional culture. Professor Philip takes notice of him and invites him to become the honorary dean.

title: （Dubbed）Forever Mine, Against All Odds
desc: Good girl Grace has always kept her secret teenage crush locked away. She once saw Damien, the school bad boy, in his pure and beautiful state and has always wanted to pull him out of his dark abyss. Her journey of brave love and redemption reveals that this isn't just a one-sided affair, but a passionate summer romance that ends with them together against all odds.

title: Gaze into the Abyss
desc:
"Steven left his wife Tessa for a chance with his first love, never realizing she was actually the heiress to the powerful Vance family.
When the Vance fortune quietly withdrew, his empire collapsed overnight. Now, desperate and begging for a second chance, he's met only with Tessa's cold rejection.
But that's not all—a new man from high society is pursuing her, and Steven's ex has returned with a hidden scheme.
Now, he's about to learn the hard way:
The wife he walked away from is now the woman he can never have back."

title: The CEO
desc:
Lucas, once a poor boy raised by his single mother, endured harsh treatment from his wealthy classmates because of his humble background while they were in school. Despite the odds, he grows up determined and becomes a successful CEO of his own thriving company. Ironically, some of his former classmates who once bullied him now work for his company, unaware of his identity because he keeps his life private. Lucas is about to make his first official appearance at the company headquarters, which has everyone excited.

On the day of Lucas's arrival, Anna, the only classmate who was ever kind to him, comes to apply for a job at the company. She has no idea Lucas is the CEO, and she doesn’t recognize him as the boy she once helped. However, her job application process turns ugly when the same group of people who bullied Lucas in the past, now his employees, humiliate her. Witnessing this cruelty, Lucas steps in. He decides to hire her directly as his personal assistant, and starts spending time with her, hoping to reveal his true identity gradually.

As their connection grows, jealousy brews among other female employees who are drawn to Lucas’s charm and power, including the daughter of Lucas's influential mentor, Daphne, who is set on becoming part of his life. Amid the rivalry and challenges, Lucas and Anna rediscover each other and begin a budding romance that surprises everyone, reminding Lucas of the simple kindness he cherished in his past.

title: （Dubbed）Secret on the Yoga Mat
desc: "Sophia believed her first love's lies, watched her daughter in danger and did nothing, convinced her husband George was a greedy fraud. Then the truth exploded—the man she despised was the silent force behind her success, while the one she trusted was stealing George's research and her fortune. By the time she understood, it was too late: George had moved on with the woman who always loved him, and her daughter had happily found a new mom. Left with nothing but regret, she realized some wounds never heal. ""The one you pushed away was the only one who ever held you up."

title: Love Me or I Die
desc:
Lauretha Thomas, a young woman struggling to find a job after months of rejection, is left feeling hopeless and frustrated. With mounting pressure from her family’s financial crisis and the weight of her own failure, Lauretha decides to escape her problems for a while. She reluctantly agrees to join her best friend, Pamela, at an exclusive, posh nightclub—far beyond her usual standards of living. Hoping for a brief distraction, she drowns her sorrows in a bottle of wine, trying to numb the anxiety that’s been eating away at her.
But what should have been a quiet night out takes a dramatic turn when she accidentally spills wine all over the shirt of Jayden McClarke, a powerful and ruthless CEO known for his cold, calculating demeanor. His icy glare makes it clear that he’s not one to tolerate mistakes, but before Lauretha can apologize or even gather herself, he grabs her arm in a tight, controlling grip. In a moment of frustration, Lauretha reacts instinctively and slaps him across the face, stunning everyone around them into silence.
The room falls into a tense hush as Jayden, momentarily taken aback, locks eyes with her. But before things can escalate further, Pamela rushes to apologize on her friend’s behalf, trying to defuse the situation. Lauretha, humiliated and overwhelmed, pulls away from her grip and quickly exits the club with Pamela, retreating from the chaos she’s just caused.

title: （Dubbed）She's Back for Vengeance
desc:
"Switched at birth, Diana is brought back to her wealthy family—only to become the outcast and meet a tragic end.
Reborn, she cuts all ties, exposes the fake heiress, and takes back everything.
But as she teams up with Charles for revenge, his gaze grows dangerously intense, and he whispers, ""Will you give me a chance to win your heart?""
——Welcome to Diana's Court. Let the judgment begin."

title: Her Vengeful Grace
desc:
"June Young, a powerful businesswoman and the third wife of the chairman of Global Finance, lost her young daughter during an internal power struggle within the company after the girl was abandoned by her father.
 After her husband's death, June took over as the CEO of Global Finance and became the target of an assassination attempt. During the attack, she was rescued by a mercenary named Sirocco, who was hiding from his own enemies. She later kept him by her side as her personal bodyguard."

title: My Poems Shake the Heavens
desc:
Lan Grant was the reincarnation of the Master Sage. When he recited poetry, it could trigger cosmic disturbances—but he had no idea.
 One time while he was reciting a poem, the Lady Fox of Azure Vale and the Goddess of Divine Eyes happened to be dueling in the Overheaven battlefield. The phenomenon seriously wounded both women.
 The two fell to the mortal world and realized Ian was unfathomably powerful. They decided to stay by his side.
 Just then, villains from the Ascendancy came hunting them down, and everyone got caught up in another storm of trouble.

title: Honey Gold
desc: Sandra Keith, beautiful, kind hearted and in love with Jade Smith, always wants what is best for her best friend, Amanda Grey. Sandra tries everything in her power to get Jade and Amanda together even though it hurts her. In a final bid to help Jade win the love of his life, Sandra agrees to be with Tony Delvin in order to make Jade a powerful man. With the stench of poverty still hanging around him, Amanda agrees to be with Jade, but she is not invested in the relationship. She confesses to Sandra that she is only with him because her father is on the brink of losing everything and she might be able to use Jade to rebuild her father’s reputation. A hurt Sandra fights between telling Jade the truth, and letting him be happy...

title: Ballad of the Phoenix Throne
desc: The legendary life of Zoey Wolfe, the first and the greatest empress of all time.

title: (Dubbed)From Cell to Cinderella
desc: After a passionate night with Simon, the richest man in Emerald City, Diana finds herself falsely accused and thrown into jail. Ten months later, she gives birth to his son and pleads with her sister Molly to deliver the child to Simon. Upon receiving his son, Simon uncovers the heartbreaking struggles Diana has endured. Once Diana is released from prison, Simon showers her with love and together, they set out to crush their enemies and build a blissful future!

title: Happy New Year
desc:
"Near the New Year's, the Hale family finally tracked down their long-lost twin children. Out of gratitude, Farron Hale and his wife Nina accepted Nora as their mother and brought her to the city to celebrate the holiday with them.
 After arriving in the city, Farron and Nina treated Nora with the utmost respect, but Nora could not stop thinking about her biological grandson. Taking advantage of the trip, she went to see him herself. But under the influence of his mother, Skye, the boy was just as cold and unkind.
 After a series of events—including the family dinner and reunion banquet—her son realized his mistakes and divorced Skye, and the whole family finally reconciled and reunited in happiness."

title: （Dubbed）Echoes of a Hollow City
desc: This is a story of gratitude, betrayal, and growth set in the world of corporate intrigue and romance. Edward secretly assists Jessica in running Starlight Entertainment, elevating it over five years. Villainous Ethan creates misunderstandings, causing Jessica to repeatedly hurt Edward until he leaves. When the company faces a crisis, Edward returns to help, but whether he forgives Jessica remains a mystery.

title: (DUBBED)Darkness Before Dawn
desc: Vicky, a wealthy heiress, marries penniless Ethan and soon becomes pregnant. A tragic accident on her delivery day kills her parents, causes her to lose her baby, and leaves her mentally impaired. For six years, she's in a wheelchair, cared for by Ethan and her best friend. But a sudden recovery reveals their affair and the shocking truth: her condition was their doing. Now, Vicky is determined to make them pay and uncover the mystery behind the car accident!

title: Crown Myself
desc: After a car accident leaves Victoria paralyzed and her boyfriend George disappears from her life, she discovers his true colors. Ready for revenge, she stops hiding her wealthy heiress status and takes back everything that's rightfully hers...

title: Medical Pioneer: Reborn
desc: Renowned medical pioneer Sean Gordon developed a revolutionary cancer cure, only to find himself abruptly transported fifty years into the past. Determined to save his mother, and driven by a mission to heal the world, he resolved to introduce the life-saving drug decades ahead of its time. But such an advanced discovery, far beyond the era's scientific understanding, was met with intense skepticism and doubt. Through relentless rounds of clinical trials, Sean gradually earned widespread recognition and emerged as a visionary leader in medicine, spearheading a new wave of medical revolution.

title: Twist of time
desc: Ethan Arturo receives an unexpected guest, Kyle Crisanto, on the day of his father’s burial. He ends up in a bar after his mother confirms that Kyle is his step-brother. When Kyle joins him at the bar, he notices that Ethan is attracted to a certain waitress, Nathalie Andrés. Kyle urges him to talk to her, but when Ethan does so, Nathalie humiliates him. To save his crumbling pride, Ethan strikes a bet with Kyle: he'd get Nathalie in his bed before the week runs out.But things soon take a different turn.In the course of the bet, Ethan and Nathalie fall in love with each other. Well, until she finds out about the bet by an anonymous tip and calls off the relationship.A few weeks goes by and she still can’t let go of her feelings for Ethan. She’s advised by her best friend Kristine Malic, to have some sort of closure so she’d be able to move on. Nathalie heeds her advise and asks for one last night with Ethan...

title: Love Me, Hate Me
desc: Whitney is framed for the death of Julian's sister. Torn between love and hatred, Julian keeps Whitney imprisoned by his side. What Whitney doesn't know is that he's doing it to protect her. Desperate to escape, she fights with everything she has to get away—only to learn the truth when it's already too late, and by then, nothing can be undone.

title: The Winter Veil
desc:
Nestled in a snow-covered valley, the isolated town of Frostwood is no stranger to mystery. When four strangers receive a letter inviting them to the reading of Eleanor Winters' will, none can fathom how their lives are about to change. Eleanor, the reclusive and wealthy owner of the town's only bed and breakfast inn, has left the inn to the group under one peculiar condition: they must all live together in her sprawling, winter-worn inn for three weeks. If anyone leaves before the time is up, the inheritance is forfeited.
Lila Monroe, a reserved bookstore owner, hopes the inheritance will help her escape the shadows of her past. Alex Reed, a disillusioned journalist, sees an opportunity to uncover Eleanor’s mysterious “death”. Jules Carter, a struggling artist, seeks inspiration but hides insecurities about their future. Lastly, Nina Winters, Eleanor’s spirited niece, is determined to uncover the secrets of her aunt’s life—and death.
As the snow deepens outside, tensions rise inside the inn. The group finds themselves entangled in a web of old wounds, hidden motives, and simmering conflicts. Relationships are tested, and unexpected bonds form as love blossoms between some while others harbor resentments. The house itself seems alive, its eerie creaks and cold drafts leading them to hidden rooms, cryptic notes, and long-buried secrets about Eleanor's life...

title: Heaven Sent Blessings
desc: On the eve of New Year, kind-hearted Yvonne was thrown out of her home by her ungrateful son and daughter-in-law. Unable to bear the decline of basic decency and morality, Heaven sent down two blessed children, Goldie and Jady, to help Yvonne, punish her heartless son and daughter-in-law, and reunite her with the biological son she had lost many years ago. Before returning to Heaven, Goldie and Jady offered New Year's blessings to all the kindhearted people in the world.

title: （Dubbed）My Ex-Wife, My Doctor
desc: After two years of marriage to Daniel Foster, Chloe Kelly had endured constant provocations from the "old mistress." Once she saw through her husband's cold indifference, she didn't hesitate—she slapped the divorce papers on the table and walked away. Daniel scoffed at first, thinking she was just being dramatic and would come crawling back soon enough. He had no idea Chloe would return to her medical roots and quickly rise to fame as a renowned men's health specialist. As for the mistress Daniel always thought of as his "savior," Jess Wever turned out to be an academic fraud in every sense—her credentials were fake, and she'd been lying to Daniel for years. By the time Daniel came groveling back, Chloe was already making waves in the men's clinic. She picked up her acupuncture needles with a smirk. "Need a treatment too, ex?"

title: Lost and Found
desc: Nailah Vernon is a successful young woman who built multiple businesses and secured her future entirely on her own. However, she suffers from amnesia caused by an accident she experienced as a child-a tragedy that also claimed her mother’s life. As a result, Nailah grew up under the care of Lumi Young's family, completely unaware of her past. Despite her success, Nailah feels incomplete, haunted by the void of forgotten memories. Her painful, fruitless attempts to recover them make her hesitant to continue. Everything changes when Felix Campbell, Raphael’s close friend, enters her life and offers to help her uncover her lost past...

title: Back to the 80s: Making My Fortune
cleanTitle: Back to the 80s: Making My Fortune
desc: Wealthy hairdressing mogul Amelia accidentally time-travels to the 1980s, becoming the neighborhood "nuisance." Her scientist husband Luke originally wanted a divorce but was always refused. Now, it's Amelia who's determined to leave him. As she focuses on making money, Luke pleads with her, saying, "If we get divorced, where will I find a wife as good as you?"

title: I Think My Wife Wants To Kill Me 2
cleanTitle: I Think My Wife Wants To Kill Me 2
desc: After the mysterious death of Madame Delacroix, Emily finds herself framed by her envious employers, Vivian and Dominic, who conspire to have her name removed from the will and to see her imprisoned for the crime. Detective Ramirez enters the fray, determined to uncover the truth, only to discover that Madame Delacroix died of natural causes and that Emily had nothing to do with her death. As the investigation unfolds, Dominic’s past comes back to haunt him when Detective Rodriguez begins probing into the suspicious circumstances surrounding Raphael’s disappearance, leading Dominic to go into hiding. Vindicated, Emily unexpectedly inherits Madame Delacroix’s vast wealth. Honoring a pact made with the late matriarch, she embarks on a quest to find her estranged son, Jamal. When she finally locates him, she offers him a position at the manor as a help, but Jamal initially refuses due to his pride, despite his impoverished state. He however changes his mind after hearing about the generous compensation on the table...

title: （Dubbed）The Grand Deception
desc: After a planned car accident leaves heiress Chloe Hayes in a coma, her husband turns into a completely different person and enemies close in. Chloe, using her blindness and amnesia as a shield, navigates through constant peril. As the truth comes to light, deep betrayals and hidden secrets are revealed. In this ruthless world, can Chloe reclaim her life and outwit her enemies?

title: When the Mist Clears
desc: This is a dramatic story of Dora and Gregory, a couple whose love began back in college and seemed headed for a happy marriage—until fate took a dark turn. After Dora is blinded in an accident while saving Gregory, she eventually regains her sight through surgery, only to discover that her fiancé has been cheating on her with his female friend, Romy. Heartbroken and betrayed, Dora decides to expose Gregory and Romy’s affair at the wedding. But that’s not all—on the same day, she stages her own fake funeral and vanishes, leaving Gregory to face the consequences of his actions. Meanwhile, at the funeral, Riley—the devoted young man who’s always cared for Dora—makes his move.

title: Revenge in Disguise
desc: Evelyn Lynn is a prodigy painter. Driven by jealousy of Evelyn's talent, the wealthy heiress Shannon Sue accidentally killed Evelyn's identical twin sister, Yvonne Lynn. To avenge her sister, Evelyn assumed the alias Evie, underwent surgery to look exactly like her enemy Shannon, and planned to infiltrate the Sue family for revenge. By a twist of fate, she discovered the secret of Sean Frost, CEO of the Frost Group: He's allergic to women...

title: （Dubbed）Reborn: The Ultimate Father-in-Law
desc:
"After his murder, billionaire Caleb wakes up three years earlier—to a time when his daughter is blinded by a hypocrite, and his son-in-law Henry is treated with contempt.
This time, he'll tear every lie apart, punish the traitors, and give everything to the only one who ever showed him loyalty: Henry.
But when the truth is finally revealed… will Henry's heart already be gone for good?
Can a second chance rewrite fate… or is some love lost forever?"

title: （Dubbed）The Three-Year Lie
desc:
"I stayed in another world for Ethan, hiding his infertility and enduring IVF alone. The day I found out I was pregnant, I caught him at a prenatal check-up with his ""true love."" Heartbroken, my system awakened, and I left, taking our child with me.

Back in the real world, I focused on my career and fell in love with my childhood friend. Obsessed, Ethan chased after me, but my heart was already cold. Eventually, I exposed his true love's fake pregnancy, saw his family go bankrupt, and found happiness with my childhood sweetheart.

""Some loves, even the system deems unworthy of a second chance."""

title: （Dubbed）Father and Son: The Dragon’s Rivalry
desc: In the concrete jungle of the city, former world champion Damian hides, burdened by the tragic loss of his wife and his own crippling injury. Twelve years later, a new dark force emerges, and his son Leo becomes an unwilling pawn in a deadly game. Will Damian rise again to fight for his family and honor against long-standing hatred and conspiracy? This is a tale packed with suspense and emotion, where power, deceit, and family collide at every turn. Join us to uncover the truth and witness the fearless comeback of a legendary fighter.

title: Axed the Ace
desc: "Salley Levit, a programming genius personally recruited by the chairman after multiple attempts, got fired by Sharon Carter—the chairman's daughter who just took over. After a series of screw-ups, Sharon mixed up Salley, the company's backbone, with Sully Levitt, the corporate leech. Sully played her like a fiddle, turning her against Salley. Fed up with the BS, Salley jumped ship to their rival, Apex Tech. As the two companies went head-to-head, Sharon kept backing the wrong horse—trusting that hack Sully—and tanked the new project completely. Meanwhile, Apex Tech shot straight to the top with Salley on their team.

title: Diamond Darling:Sweet Pregnancy Love
desc: After a chance encounter, Elara and Aiden had a son, Jackson. Six years later, Aiden discovered the child's existence and began searching for him. During this time, Elara grew closer to Aiden while working at his company, and feelings slowly developed between them. Eventually, Jackson was recognized as Aiden's heir, and Elara found security and happiness as his mother.

title: （Dubbed）The Quiet War
desc:
"A top-tier doctor returned home, only to be greeted by her husband and his mistress's ""love child""? Her in-laws declared without a shred of guilt: ""You will raise this child!""
Chloe smiled. She sold their house and car, playing the devoted wife—until the day of the birth. Then she slipped off her wedding ring, donated every last cent, and left the country.
Overnight, the wealthy family crumbled into debt and ruin. Six years later, she returned with a love worthy of her, only to find her ex-husband on his knees at the airport, begging for her back.
She merely smiled faintly: ""Belated affection is cheaper than weeds."

title: My Ice-Cold CEO Wife
desc: He is the legendary "Grim Reaper"—a war machine who makes the underworld tremble in terror. After a life-altering incident, he returns to the city and enters a marriage of convenience with an ice-cold female CEO. This is a story about living boldly, breaking the rules, and rewriting the game on your own terms.

title: Little Mother, Big Heart
desc: Laura Lane suffers from dwarfism and endures constant disdain and ridicule, losing hope in life. Just as she contemplates ending it all, she encounters the baby Lunaria, reigniting her will to live. Laura decides to raise Lunaria into adulthood. However, the village bully, Luke Strong, covets Lunaria's beauty and resorts to threats, bribery, and even violence. The mother and daughter fight back fiercely, enduring humiliation, and Laura is left severely injured as a result.

title: Mother's Confession
desc: Twenty years ago, Susan eloped with Kieran Smith, abandoning her husband and daughter. Now, twenty years later, she returns home due to kidney failure, pleading with her daughter Gianna Sharpe to donate a kidney. Gianna, feeling abandoned, refuses and faces moral pressure from her mother along with threats from her brother Dylan Smith. Dylan attempts to bully Gianna and insult her father, David Sharpe, unaware that Gianna is the CEO of the Celestial Corp.

title: Retired, Not Obsolete
desc: On his last day before retirement, veteran electrician Gregory faced a plant-wide blackout at Gale Works. Rushing to troubleshoot, he discovered his apprentice Mark had not only neglected circuit maintenance in his rush to cut corners, but had also attempted a reckless bypass to cover up the failure—causing a cascading grid collapse across the entire facility. When Gregory tried to restore power, he was falsely accused, slapped across the face, and forced to sign his retirement papers on the spot. After retirement, Gregory unexpectedly helped Goodman Industries solve a complex grid failure that had stumped even European specialists. Not only was he offered a high-salary return, but international firms also lined up to bid on his patented solutions…

title: Darkness Before Dawn
desc: Vicky, a wealthy heiress, marries penniless Ethan and soon becomes pregnant. A tragic accident on her delivery day kills her parents, causes her to lose her baby, and leaves her mentally impaired. For six years, she's in a wheelchair, cared for by Ethan and her best friend. But a sudden recovery reveals their affair and the shocking truth: her condition was their doing. Now, Vicky is determined to make them pay and uncover the mystery behind the car accident!

title: The Day I Gave Birth, I Divorced
cleanTitle: The Day I Gave Birth, I Divorced
desc:
She gave up everything for love.
He gave her nothing but betrayal.
When her powerful father arrived, three billionaires knelt to greet him. Her husband finally understood—he'd married an empire… and destroyed it.
Now, with their baby gone and lies spreading online, the real war begins.
Some betrayals can only be paid in blood.

title: Professor, Your Brother Dumped Me
desc:
The night Julian Wright orchestrated his "rose ceremony," everyone expected a full meltdown.
They were taking bets—would I show up sobbing, or would I skip straight to the roof? After all, everyone knew I was broke. Without Julian's money, I'd be out on my ass.
But when Julian handed that rose to campus queen Chloe Miller, the ballroom doors never opened. No crying. No scene. The whole party lost its main event.
What nobody knew was that while Julian was busy playing bachelor, I was sitting on his half-brother's leather couch in nothing but an oversized white dress shirt. Bare legs tucked under me.
I glanced up at Vincent, catching my lower lip between my teeth. "Your couch is soaked. Where exactly are you planning to sleep tonight?"
Vincent Wright's throat worked. Hard. He dragged his gaze away like it physically hurt. When he spoke, his voice came out wrecked: "Stay put. I'll grab a towel."
A beat. Then rougher: "Need to get you dry."

title: Crown of Vengeance
desc:
"Audrey Shayne, daughter of the Prime Minister, enters the palace under the name of Isabella Cole, the daughter of a lower-rank Censor, in order to avenge her family. Step by step, she rises from a Noble Lady to the highest rank of Palace, plotting each move carefully.
 She once believed the downfall of her family and the death of the former Queen were caused by the scheming women of the Palace. But as she investigates, she uncovers a shocking truth: it was King Michael himself who orchestrated it all."

title: Unforgotten Love
desc: What is love? It's Miles and Tessa, separated for five years, yet somehow finding their way back to each other. It's every word spoken in denial, every excuse that carves a fresh wound on your own heart before the other party. It's that simple confession: "Tessa, all I want is you." The world is vast, but all I ask for is just one person to love.

title: No Love in Vain
desc:
"Every night, Vance is haunted by dreams of a pair of bloody hands reaching for him. Everything changes when he meets Natalie. After an unexpected kiss, Vance realizes Natalie may be the key to breaking the curse that has been tormenting him. At the same time, Natalie begins seeing him in her own dreams. She first approaches him because of work, but as their lives become more deeply entangled, real feelings begin to grow between them.
As the curse worsens, Vance's health begins to fail. Then Natalie uncovers a terrifying truth: she may be the very source of the curse. Determined to save him, she sets out to find a way to break it, only to discover that everything is tied to a tragic bond from a past life. Caught between misunderstanding and revelation, the two struggle against fate, unable to let each other go.
Across a hundred years of reincarnation, love and hatred remain intertwined, drawing them back together once more. Through tears, Natalie faces him and says, ""Vance, I never forgot you. I've always been able to see you.""
After a love story stretched across a century, obsession, and destiny, can they finally find their happy ending?"

title: His Contracted Virgin
desc:
25-year-old housewife Sadie Miller, desperate to salvage her marriage with her cold, unfaithful husband Shawn, tries to learn about sex from a professional escort.
But there, she crosses paths with Guy Hawkins—the mafia boss of the Hawkins Syndicate, who numbs his pain from losing his family as a child through violence and BDSM. Drawn to Sadie's innocence and embarrassment, Guy proposes a one-month contract: she'll accompany him under the terms of an S&M agreement.
For Shawn's safety, Sadie accepts. Amidst training, humiliation, and temptation, she finds herself growing emotionally dependent on Guy.
After weathering emotional turmoil and life-threatening danger together, Sadie and Guy move beyond their master-servant roles. They become true partners, bound by love and a vow to each other.

title: Rejected by the Alpha, Claimed by the Northern King
cleanTitle: Rejected by the Alpha, Claimed by the Northern King
desc: Ella, a wolfless girl abandoned by her fated mate and cruelly exploited by her family, falls into despair and personally severs her mate bond. Forced to marry in her sister’s place, she becomes the wife of Luke — the legendary “useless” Alpha of the North who is also believed to be wolfless. Unexpectedly, Ella helps Luke awaken his wolf spirit, earning the overwhelming devotion of the entire North. Meanwhile, her ex-mate Alpha Noah, after uncovering the truth, is consumed by madness and regret, willing to do anything to win her back

title: I Was Dead While They Cut the Cake
cleanTitle: I Was Dead While They Cut the Cake
desc:
While I bled to death locked in a storage room, my fiancé Adrian was holding my sister's hand, comforting her.
He hung up on my final call for help, leaving only a voicemail: "If anything happens to Lena, the engagement is off."
My sister once said her birthday wish had always been for me to disappear.
That night, her wish came true early.
But my soul never left.
I watched everyone gather around her, singing happy birthday.
As she blew out the candles, I whispered in her ear:
"Enjoy it while it lasts. This will be your last birthday."

title: She Rose Like the Sun
desc:
[The Wife Who Survived & the Current Mrs. Yancy Who's Cornered—Two Women, One Husband, and Both Want Him Dead!]
Zach Yancy clawed his way up the social ladder by murdering his wife for insurance money. But Linda, the ex-wife he thought was long dead, survived—and now she's back. Step by step, she shatters Chloe—the Current Mrs. Yancy's—fantasy of a perfect marriage. What starts as hostility between two women turns into an uneasy alliance as they join forces to rip apart Zach's carefully crafted mask. Together, they expose his lies, take back what was stolen from them, and make him pay for every last thing he did. A high-stakes revenge story packed with twists, mind games, and ruthless payback—girls helping girls is more than just a slogan!

title: I Taught Him to Court a Mate — He Chose Me
cleanTitle: I Taught Him to Court a Mate — He Chose Me
desc: The Ph.D. candidate Thea personally taught a lone male dragon courtship calls and the Flame Dance to complete her thesis. The drag

title: The Billionaire Ex-Wife's Glory After Divorce

title: Feito pra Ficar Rico II
desc: Nos anos 90 em Porto Maré, Noah Almeida, um homem comum vindo das camadas mais baixas da sociedade, conquistou seu espaço após um ano de trabalho duro. Chamou a atenção da Joaquim Santos e assumiu o negócio dos jogos de azar.Com inteligência, revitalizou o negócio e expandiu para as loterias de Porto Maré. Conquistou riqueza e networking. Apesar de ter quase afundado por ganância nos negócios, manteve-se fiel aos seus princípios e, no fim, renasceu — como a lagarta que se transforma em borboleta. Completou a jornada de homem comum a homem de sucesso.

title: O Imperador Imortal Renasceu
desc: O Imperador Azul, Júlio Ribeiro, renasce aos 19 anos, trazendo consigo cinco séculos de memórias de cultivo e o Segredo da Eternidade. Diante dos inimigos de sua vida passada e das intrigas das famílias poderosas, ele usa seu poder transcendente para proteger seus parentes, punir os covardes, consertar seus arrependimentos e recomeçar uma lenda de vida.
